club.title: Club
club.aboutText: Thép Xanh Nam Định Football Club, founded in 1965, is one of the most storied and traditional clubs in Vietnamese football. From its original name Thanh Niên Nam Hà, the club has undergone over 14 name changes, each marking a chapter in Vietnamese football history. Dubbed 'Juventus of Vietnam' in the 1980s-1990s for their iconic black-and-white striped kit, the club cemented their legacy with an unbeaten season in 1985 — a feat achieved by only two clubs in Vietnamese football history.
club.stadiumDesc: Thiên Trường Stadium, located in the heart of Nam Định city, was rebuilt in 2000 and inaugurated on August 30, 2003. With a capacity of approximately 30,000 seats and a 115x72m international-standard pitch, it stands as one of the most electrifying atmospheres in Vietnamese football.
club.stadiumFact1Desc: A nickname inspired by Old Trafford's 'Theatre of Dreams,' combined with Nam Định's famous textile industry heritage.
club.stadiumFact2Desc: Received over 25 billion VND investment for upgrades to host men's football group-stage matches at SEA Games 31 (2022), with free admission.
club.stadiumFact3Desc: Modern LED lighting system meets AFC Champions League standards, ready for international competitions.
club.fansDesc: Thiên Trường is renowned for its passionate atmosphere, regularly packed with over 30,000 fans. The V.League 2023-24 championship victory after 39 years of waiting sparked celebrations across the entire Nam Định province, with the coronation ceremony hailed as the most spectacular in Vietnamese football history.
